template.content:
{#- pw2bgw.x writes output files to outdir/<file>; the "../" prefix places them in the job
    working directory, where the BerkeleyGW executables expect them. real_or_complex = 1 matches
    the real flavor of BerkeleyGW (epsilon.real.x) and requires inversion symmetry. -#}
&input_pw2bgw
    prefix = '__prefix__'
    outdir = {% raw %}'{{ JOB_WORK_DIR }}/outdir'{% endraw %}
    real_or_complex = 1
    wfng_flag = .true.
    wfng_file = '../WFN'
    wfng_kgrid = .true.
    wfng_nk1 = {{ kgrid.dimensions[0] }}
    wfng_nk2 = {{ kgrid.dimensions[1] }}
    wfng_nk3 = {{ kgrid.dimensions[2] }}
    wfng_dk1 = 0.0
    wfng_dk2 = 0.0
    wfng_dk3 = 0.0
    rhog_flag = .true.
    rhog_file = '../RHO'
{#- vxc_diag_nmax must not exceed nbnd in pw_bands_bgw_wfn.in #}
    vxc_flag = .true.
    vxc_file = '../vxc.dat'
    vxc_diag_nmin = 1
    vxc_diag_nmax = 35
    vxc_offdiag_nmin = 0
    vxc_offdiag_nmax = 0
/
template.name: pw2bgw_wfn.in
